info.name: Registration
info.description:
Rhythm ERP Registration module. Covers Supplier, Customer, Employee, Agent, Farmer.

Setup: import + set token/tenant_id in Rhythm ERP Environment.

item.name: Supplier
item.description:
Supplier CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update.

Key rules:
- PAN must be unique (format: ABCDE1234F)
- Both Shipping (address_type=43) AND Billing (address_type=42) rows mandatory
- mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers, NOT strings
- Additional Details fields sit on the stepper object, NOT inside details[]
- No Delete endpoint exists

item.name: Customer
item.description:

Key rules:
- sale_type_ref_id always Commission (1267 fallback — resolve live for tenant)
- supply_type_ref_id always Both (225 fallback — resolve live for tenant)
- PAN must be unique; mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers
- Additional Details fields sit on the stepper object, NOT inside details[]
- No Delete endpoint exists

item.name: Employee
item.description:
Employee CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create, PUT /Employee/{id}/ for Update.

Key rules:
- Flat form — no steppers, no children
- mobile_no must be integer, NOT string
- designation: FK from Designation screen
- department: FK from Department screen
- UPDATE uses PUT /Employee/{id}/, not the dynamic-screen-wrapper POST
- No Delete endpoint exists

request.description: Paginated list of Employees records.
Full Employee record. Set employee_id in environment.
Creates a new Employee. id must be empty string "".
Updates an Employee. Uses PUT /Employee/{id}/ — different from all other modules which use POST dynamic-screen-wrapper.

item.name: Farmer
item.description:
Farmer CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update.

Key rules:
- farmer_category is a single integer FK (NOT an array)
- Tenant-specific category IDs: 1592=Walk-in, 1593=FPC Member, 1594=Borrower Farmer
- mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers
- Address requires BOTH Permanent (1875) AND Current (1876) rows
- Additional Details + Other Details: fields sit on stepper object, NOT inside details[]
- Stepper order: Address, Family, Additional, Other, Land, Crop, KYC, Vehicle, Income, Bank, Irrigation, Award, Loan
- Borrower=13 steppers; FPC Member=6; Walk-in=3
- No Delete endpoint exists
